rows.metric: Multi-spec fake-RED blast radius (v7.121.x, 31 real builds)
rows.value: 1/31 builds was gate-hung by the bug; 100% unblocked (3/3 critical items)
rows.detail: Ran the fixed verifier across all 31 real captured build checklists. HONEST scope: only 1 build (cdbbb5af) had a CRITICAL item that the old BRE-grep verifier fake-RED-blocked to a hang; the fix rescues all 3 of its critical items (gate no longer hard-fails). Other patterns that errored under BRE were on non-critical items or builds that reached a verdict anyway, so the bug's real blast radius in the captured set is 1 build -- not systemic. Fix is correct+complete for the affected population; population is small. Newly-hit builds of the same shape (LLM ERE endpoint patterns as critical checks) are protected going forward.

rows.value: 3h50m timeout -> <10min converge (>23x); $11.83 wasted -> yields a verdict
rows.detail: Real cdbbb5af build: Timeline shows work done in ~4.6min (Iter1 + all gates Pass), then hung 3h45m on the fake-RED gate and TIMED OUT with no verdict (~$11.83 wasted). The v7.121.x fix unblocks the gate at work-completion, so the same work yields 'Working, with gaps' in <10min instead of a discarded timeout. CAVEAT: 'after' is a conservative extraction-proven bound (exact wall-clock needs a paid live re-run); within-product before/after, NOT a competitor benchmark.
rows.source: founder build Timeline (cdbbb5af) + chain-to-green extraction on real .loki state

rows.value: 0 LLM calls in verify path; 3 model dialects -> identical verdicts
rows.detail: Static+runtime proof: the completion verifier (checklist-verify.py) makes ZERO LLM/model API calls -- its only network call is a localhost HTTP GET to the app-under-test (behavioral check). Verdict = pure fn(pattern, filesystem, app-response). Same requirement in 3 model dialects (escaped-paren, alternation, quantifier) -> all True, stable across 5 runs each. Model-agnostic by construction: no model output can change a verdict.
rows.source: autonomy/checklist-verify.py static AST scan + deterministic run_check replay

rows.detail: function-extraction of checklist-verify.py against the real failing workspace cdbbb5af: four trust fixes (grep BRE->ERE, runner-agnostic tests_pass, path|target|file alias, positive 'N passed' proof) turned 3 critical false-negatives green. Verified items 1/11 -> 4/11. HONEST CAVEAT: converges the card to 'Working, with gaps', NOT a green Verified card -- that still needs the Evidence Receipt axes (build/security/healthcheck).
rows.source: commits 52fab952, 72ecc81b; autonomy/checklist-verify.py + tests, function-extraction on cdbbb5af

rows.detail: LLM ERE patterns like app\.get\('/api/tasks') errored under BRE (grep rc>=2) so present endpoints read as failing, driving the build to time out after 9 iterations. Fix: grep -E. Chain re-run on cdbbb5af converges.
rows.source: commit 52fab952; autonomy/checklist-verify.py + tests, function-extraction on cdbbb5af

rows.detail: tests_pass was hardcoded to npx jest; a passing 26/26 vitest suite read 'not run'. Fix: runner-agnostic (npm test / project scripts.test). Verified on cdbbb5af's real vitest suite.
rows.source: commit 52fab952; autonomy/checklist-verify.py + tests, function-extraction on cdbbb5af

rows.detail: tests_pass now requires positive proof [1-9]\d* passed, closing a fake-green where a no-op scripts.test (echo done / exit 0) or a zero-count ('0 passing') read green with zero tests. Caught by release council over 2 rounds; RED/GREEN verified.
13 iters/11 claims -> 1 iter/1 claim, real builds
no-promise run w/ green evidence evaluates at MIN_ITERATIONS; same full council_evaluate (no fake-green). RED/GREEN verified.
test-fixture threshold values (100 - 5*medium - 2*low), NOT measured on production builds yet
arithmetic projection from reviewer count, NOT a measured dollar figure; advisory-only score, opt-in enforcement
source-grounded checklist; zero false High findings on 3 clean real-framework fixtures

rows.value: NOT VERIFIED -> VERIFIED on identical work
rows.detail: live calibration builds of the SHIPPED artifact: same correct+tested Node deliverable recorded runner:none/not_run (headline NOT VERIFIED) on v7.115, and runner:node-test/pass:true/status:verified on v7.116. node --test detection added to both the in-loop gate and loki verify.

acs.live_note: Convergence deltas are measured on real builds; quality_score is a designed threshold and review cost is an arithmetic projection (labeled). A live v7.114 calibration confirms the composed behavior end-to-end. The v7.121.x checklist-verifier convergence deltas are measured via function-extraction on the real failing cdbbb5af workspace and yield convergence to "Working, with gaps", not a green Verified card.

didnt_work.what: wave-7 batch included an embeddings-only signal for anti-pattern memory dedupe; reverted as inert
didnt_work.reason: Added no actual behavior change; core fix was the dedup logic, not the embedding signal

didnt_work.what: PRD-reuse on rerun assumed rebuild-always: a loki start with no PRD over an already-completed project would rebuild the full task queue and re-run the entire RARV loop, redoing finished work
didnt_work.reason: Reuse path never asked 'is this spec already satisfied by current code?'
didnt_work.outcome: Fixed in v7.94.0 with done-recognition gate; rebuild-always approach retired

didnt_work.what: RARV instruction 'There is NEVER a finished state - always find the next improvement' was emitted in every mode, including finite PRD/checkpoint runs - a direct self-contradiction and the prompt root of 14-iteration convergence bug
didnt_work.reason: Intended for perpetual/no-promise mode only; biased model toward redundant self-verification in finite builds
didnt_work.outcome: Mode-aware rarv instruction; finite runs now get stop-when-verified-done directive

didnt_work.what: local-ci.sh parallelized for speed; non-hermetic tests began flaking under concurrent execution, making the gate non-deterministic
didnt_work.reason: Shared temp state between lanes; ordering dependencies not accounted for

mistakes.what: Bun runner FIX A: first attempt used broad blocked||escalated gate that over-blocked clean runs
mistakes.how_fixed: Rewrote to gate only on real code_review BLOCK (hardGates); clean runs complete again

mistakes.what: Completion gates armed with type-probe that silently skipped if council library failed to source; allowed unverified completion (fake-green)
mistakes.how_fixed: Gate chain now verifies core functions are loadable before running; refuses claim if any missing (fail-closed)

mistakes.what: Council force-review path had same fail-open hole: partial library load force-approved completion ungated
mistakes.how_fixed: Force-review now probes core gate functions before approving

mistakes.what: server.py /api/tasks raised AttributeError on malformed dashboard-state.json (non-dict tasks or task groups not lists), 500ing and blanking the whole task board
mistakes.how_fixed: State-group reader now coerces defensively; non-dict tasks treated as empty

mistakes.what: Completion council only evaluated every 5 iterations; build verifiably done at iteration 1 (19/19 tests green, checklist complete) ran 13 more needless iterations. Pathological case: 14 iterations, ~97 min wall-clock for work done in ~2 min
mistakes.caught_by: Real build telemetry (anonima events.jsonl) + speed diagnosis
mistakes.how_fixed: Explicit completion claim now triggers immediate council evaluation; no-claim cadence unchanged

mistakes.what: LOKI_COUNCIL_THRESHOLD operator config was silently ignored; hardcoded 2/3 formula used even when operator set stricter threshold
mistakes.how_fixed: Effective threshold = max(2/3 floor, operator threshold), shared helper at all three vote sites

mistakes.what: v7.81.0 python test registered as command string in run-all-tests.sh but runner exec's via bash; local-ci passed (different contract), CI failed post-push
mistakes.how_fixed: Bash wrapper added; pattern now consistent across both gates
